title: Netanyahu’s ‘super-Sparta’ vision braces Israel for isolated economic future
summary: Israeli PM’s outline of partial autarky and more militarised society stirs up backlash and concern over pariah status Middle East crisis – live updates Hours before unleashing a ground offensive against Gaza City on Tuesday, Benjamin Netanyahu braced his country for a future of mounting economic isolation, urging it to become a “super Sparta ” of the Middle East. The future the prime minister laid out for Israel, of a more militarised society, a partial autarky – or economically self-sufficient country – with limited trade options and relying increasingly on homemade production, has stirred up a backlash among Israelis who are ever more uneasy at the prospect of following him down the path to a pariah state. summary: Ministers hoped to finalise deal this week that would reduce president’s steel tariffs to zero A long-coveted deal to slash US steel and aluminium tariffs to zero has been shelved on the eve of Donald Trump’s state visit to Britain, the Guardian has learned.
